run_generate_multiview_images: run the script to generate multiview images from a metadata JSON file with scene poses
generate_multiview_images_from_metadata: generate color and depth images for a scene by rendering viewpoints from metadata poses
render_viewpoint_with_generator: render a viewpoint using MultiviewHabitatSimGenerator with a position and quaternion orientation
save_depth_and_camera_params: save depth images as EXR files and camera intrinsics as JSON alongside color images
overload_metadata_params: override specific metadata parameters when generating multiview images from a metadata file
